{{Quote|He once told me that a tiny fever wasp can carry death into places where a Krayt dragon cannot go. I have to be that fever wasp, Ganner. I have a plan to rescue the Princess.|Antares Draco, recalling the teachings of Eshkar Niin|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
In [[138 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], two [[Imperial Knight]]s and one [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to rescue [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]]. Fel had been [[Operation: Thunderstroke|kidnapped]] by forces of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] during a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&ndash;Imperial Knight [[Mission to Agamar|peace conference]] on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]-in-exile [[Roan Fel]] tasked [[Antares Draco]]&mdash;leader of the Imperial Knights and lover of the Princess&mdash;with either rescuing or [[Death/Legends|killing]] her, lest she betray Imperial secrets to [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]]. By focusing his anger, Draco disguised himself as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and he arrived on Korriban with fellow Imperial Knight [[Ganner Krieg]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]] posing as captives he had taken on Agamar.

The three infiltrated Korriban's [[XoXaan's Temple|Sith Temple]] and rescued Fel, who revealed that Draco's former Master, [[Darth Havok|Eshkar Niin]], had become the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Havok and subjected her to [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. The group then [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|cut their way]] through Sith as they retreated to their [[Sith–Imperial attack ship|waiting ship]], but Draco, determined to see the Princess escape, remained on Korriban's surface as his comrades fled the planet. After slaughtering a wave of attackers with a stolen [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]], he was approached by Havok, who beseeched him to embrace his anger and join the Sith. Draco's refusal led to a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], which Havok won with the use of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Fel was safely ferried to her [[Parent/Legends|father's]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], but Draco was left at the mercy of Havok, who sought to torture Imperial secrets out of his new [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Your Majesty, the Princess will not break!''"<br />"Anyone'' can be broken.|Antares Draco and Roan Fel|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
[[File:Wellalwayshaveagamar.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Marasiah Fel is left behind on Agamar.]]
In [[137 ABY]], the rule of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] was contested by various rebel groups during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Late in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]], representatives from the [[Empire-in-exile]] and the [[New Jedi Order]] [[Mission to Agamar|met]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to secure an [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|Alliance]] against [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|Sith]]&ndash;Imperial forces, but their rendezvous was interrupted by an Imperial [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attack]].<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref> The [[Imperial Knight]]s of the Empire-in-exile and their new [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] allies [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fought off]] attacking [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and cleared a path for [[Roan Fel]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]-in-exile, to flee Agamar aboard an [[Defender One|escape shuttle]]. Most of his surviving brethren joined him, but [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]], Imperial Knight [[Azlyn Rae]], and the Emperor's daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]], were unable to board the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Legacy 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>

Although Rae and Tuum stole a [[Sith–Imperial attack ship]] and returned to their Emperor's [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]<ref name="Legacy 49" /> in early [[138 ABY]],<ref name="Extremes Trade" /> Marasiah Fel was kidnapped by Krayt's [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|forces]] and taken to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. There, she was subjected to physical and mental [[Torture/Legends|torture]] by the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Havok]], who had once been the Imperial Knight Eshkar Niin<ref name="Legacy 49" /> before [[Rooftop duel|killing]] Fel's [[Elliah Fel|mother]] and defecting to the Sith.<ref name="Legacy 50" /> Fel refused to divulge any Imperial secrets, but her [[Parent/Legends|father]] was well aware that she knew all of the Empire-in-exile's codes and the [[Taivas|location]] of the Jedi's [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]]. After learning of his daughter's location from<ref name="Legacy 49" /> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]],<ref name="Legacy War 2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref> his [[Spy/Legends|spy]] within Krayt's Empire, Roan tasked Imperial Knight leader [[Antares Draco]] with rescuing the Princess. If that proved impossible, Draco's orders were to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Antares, I was wrong! I feel it in the Force&mdash;in my heart! You're not in league with Havok! You are true to the Empire! Don't die here!''"<br />"''That is for the will of the Force to decide. But if I die, it will be knowing you are safe! I ''love'' you, Sia, and that will never change! Now, you must go!|Marasiah Fel and Antares Draco|<ref name="Legacy 50" />}}
Draco retired to his [[Antares Draco's quarters|quarters]] and consulted the [[Eshkar Niin's holocron|holocron]] of his former Master&mdash;Eshkar Niin,<ref name="Legacy 49" /> whom Draco believed he had killed years beforehand.<ref name="Legacy 50" /> Torn between his love for Fel and his duty to stay and protect the Emperor, he only formed a rescue plan after recalling one of Niin's lessons. Niin had told Draco that a tiny [[Fever wasp/Legends|fever wasp]] was capable of bringing death to places where a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] could not, and as such, Draco prepared a small-scale infiltration mission. After covering his body with artificial Sith [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], Draco completed his [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] disguise by focusing the anger he felt over Fel's kidnapping. He traveled to Korriban<ref name="Legacy 49" /> in the attack [[Starship/Legends|ship]],<ref name="Legacy 50" /> with fellow Imperial Knight [[Ganner Krieg]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]] posing as captives he had taken on Agamar. On Korriban's surface, they entered the planet's [[XoXaan's Temple|Sith Temple]], and Draco bullied a [[Unidentified Neimoidian Sith|Sith guard]] into granting them access to the [[Chambers of Persuasion]], from where he could [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] Fel's pain, sorrow, and defiance.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

[[File:Whenourpowerscombine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ganner Krieg and Shado Vao slay Sith inside the Chambers of Persuasion.]]
Several Sith led Draco and his allies into the chambers, where an exhausted Fel hung inside an [[Force field/Legends|energy field]] during a brief respite from her torture. Krieg and Vao used [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to seize the guards' [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|Double-bladed lightsabers]] and quickly cut them down; Draco then released Fel and cradled her in his [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. She was furious with him, however, believing that he was a traitor who had lied about killing Eshkar Niin. Draco was stunned to discover that his former Master lived, but Vao, sensing approaching enemies, urged them on to their escape ship. Fel took up a [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] of her own, and the four of them fought their way through a large group of Sith after leaving the temple. After killing every enemy who stood in their way, the group reached the ship, but they sensed the approach of additional foes. Draco was adamant that the Princess escape, and he volunteered to remain on-world and hold off the attackers while his allies fled the planet.<ref name="Legacy 50" />

Fel, having realized that Draco was not a traitor, objected to his plan and volunteered to fight at his side, but Krieg dragged her onto the ship to ensure that their mission did not end up being for naught. Vao [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] them away from the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blasts of [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]] and into Korriban's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] as Krieg [[Gunner/Legends|manned]] the ship's [[Laser cannon/Legends|guns]], and Draco, with [[Jar'Kai/Legends|two lightsabers]] in hand, furiously cut down a wave of attacking Sith. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Havok then approached him and complimented him on his anger, opining that Draco would make a fine Sith himself. Draco was simply eager to finally kill his former Master, and the two engaged in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. The contest moved from the ship's landing pad to inside the Sith Temple, and both combatants used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to fuel their attacks. Both of them accordingly felt a wave of dark side energy as Darth Krayt&mdash;widely believed to be dead&mdash;projected his will across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from<ref name="Legacy 50" /> deep beneath the surface of Korriban.<ref name="Legacy 49" /> Draco was shocked, and Havok, observing his use of the dark side, offered him a final chance to join the Sith. When Draco refused, Havok struck him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and ended the fight. Fel, Krieg, and Vao were shocked to [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|feel]] Draco's apparent death in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="Legacy 50" /> but they completed their escape and returned to Bastion.<ref name="Legacy War 1" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Your failure is complete&mdash;the Princess was retaken&mdash;your friends slain. Information ''now''&mdash;or I will kill her as I killed her mother!|Darth Havok, while torturing Antares Draco|<ref name="Legacy War 1" />}}
[[File:Abrokenman.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Antares Draco reveals the location of the Jedi's Hidden Temple.]]
On Bastion, Fel refused to believe that Draco was dead, and she employed her uncle, [[Hogrum Chalk]]&mdash;the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]]&mdash;to seek information on him from [[Spy/Legends|spies]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. However, Fel's father held a [[Imperial Knight remembrance ceremony|remembrance ceremony]] for Draco and the Imperial Knights who had died on Agamar, which was attended by the Princess, Vao, and over twenty Imperial Knights. On Korriban, Havok took Draco [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] and inflicted physical torture upon him in the hope of learning Imperial secrets. When a defiant Draco told him nothing,<ref name="Legacy War 1" /> Havok used a [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|Force illusion]] to bring Draco back to the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] that he had witnessed Havok kill Fel's mother, preying upon Draco's guilt at having been unable to stop it.<ref name="Legacy War 2" />

Havok brought Draco back to the present, but his illusion disguised the [[Hand (One Sith)|Sith Hand]] [[Darth Talon]] as Marasiah Fel. Claiming that Draco's mission had failed and that Fel had been recaptured, Havok threatened to kill the Princess unless Draco gave him vital information. Desperate, Draco revealed the location of the Jedi's Hidden Temple.<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> Darth Krayt prepared for an [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attack]] and hoped for an opportunity to crush the combined forces of the Alliance; as such, he had Draco [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and delivered to the former Jedi [[Cade Skywalker]]. When Skywalker learned what Draco had revealed, he rushed to the Hidden Temple, where the entire Alliance planned a last stand. Fel was visiting the temple at the time, and, although furious that Draco had betrayed his honor by spilling secrets, she recalled the courage he had shown while rescuing her. She thus gave the broken man a chance to fight in the battle and reclaim his honor.<ref name="Legacy War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Antares Draco's mission to Korriban appears in the [[Legacy (2006) 49|forty-ninth]] and [[Legacy (2006) 50|fiftieth]] issues of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series written by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]]. Both issues were penciled by Duursema and released in [[2010]].<ref name="Legacy 49" /> Although Draco's friends feel his death in the Force at the end of the mission,<ref name="Legacy 50" /> his survival is revealed in the [[Legacy — War 1|first issue]] of the followup miniseries [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']], which was also released in 2010.<ref name="Legacy War 1" /> However, Duursema confirmed Draco's survival on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] one month prior to the issue's release.<ref name="survival confirmed">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31365466|board=Literature|thread=Legacy: War #3|user=[[Jan Duursema|Jan_Duursema]]|date=2010-11-11|time=4:17 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802121915/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/legacy-war-3.31364017/page-2}}</ref>
